entries.title: Dracodia / terminal collapse, ten-stage downloads and full-squad return
entries.note: Real native Furious final-hit checkpoint: main core55HP, other life pools/limbs depleted before filming. Input-only invulnerable pilot fires the final native shots; no recorder HP/phase/clock changes.24 accelerating formation-style lightning strikes, white1015 material, increasingly rapid idle/overhead robotic scream poses, electrified ColeForge explosion packs, rapid downloads through all nine stages plus coastalX,56 exact source-body fragments. Blue mechanical gated portal leads to a newly generated above-ground riverfront with animated water, separate far/near parallax and all eight other exact current aircraft. Native campaign reunion gives the single reward and reaches Stage Clear. No MKII graphics/audio are used.
